title: Overcoming the Randomness-Utility Trade-off in Answering Differentially Private Linear Queries
evidence: Section 1.2 and references WDP+22/23/24 explicitly cite P24/P25/P26; Section 3 develops multi-scale secluded partitions. The AI Disclosure Statement reports Lean4 checking of a construction.
limit: No public matching Lean artifact was verified in this follow-up, and no exact thesis conjecture resolution is credited. The new paper’s privacy parameter epsilon is not automatically the thesis partition tolerance.

title: Velocity-vorticity formulation of the three dimensional generalized Navier-Stokes equations: Effect of algebraic calming on well-posedness, convergence, determining wavenumber and regularity criteria
evidence: Full public text recovered. Theorems 3.2(a) and 3.3(a) state weak existence for alpha >= 1 and uniqueness for alpha >= 5/4, assuming the specified smooth bounded calming function and derivative bound. References 17–19 cite the Enlow article family.
limit: The higher-dissipation uniqueness theorem does not cover the alpha=1 dissertation regime; damping and calming hypotheses must also be preserved. No matching proof-assistant artifact identified or built.

title: Generalized saturation game
evidence: Introduction cites generalized saturation research; reference 15 is Radcliffe–Volk P27. The later paper studies a game variant and states its own unresolved exact-score questions. Journal DOI 10.1016/j.dam.2025.05.014.
limit: A game saturation number is not the static extremal minimum. No resolution of the six selected Volk questions is credited; preprint first posted 2024.
